sources.entry: diaspora* - Distributed social networking server. (Source Code) AGPL-3.0 Ruby

summary.one_liner: diaspora* is a privacy-aware, distributed, open source social network server, where independently run "pods" federate with each other.
summary.what_it_does: The README is brief and mostly points to external resources: a project site, wiki, bugtracker, discussions/support forum, and installation, user, admin, and developer FAQs. It states that users can join the network without installing anything by signing up on one of the many open servers connected to diaspora*. It also says people can install diaspora* on their own server, either to try it out or to run a pod, and that development setup guides exist for contributors. The README does not describe specific features, and it does not give technical install steps. Security reports are handled via a SECURITY.md file.
use_cases: try out a distributed social network
find an open server to join
contribute to an open source social network
how_to_run: See the installation guides linked from the project wiki or site (the README itself gives no commands).
notable: Distributed design: users sign up on independently run servers (pods) that are connected to one network
Documented guides for installing a pod, for users, and for developers
Has a code of conduct and a documented security reporting process (SECURITY.md)
caveats: The README gives no concrete install or run commands; setup details live in external guides
Running a pod is a server administration task, so self-hosting requires technical effort
keywords: run my own social media server
